transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, doctor, I'm here because I'm having a real problem with my eating. What scares me most is that... once I start eating, I just can't seem to stop. It feels like my hands just keep reaching for more food, even while I’m sitting there telling myself, "Tom, stop this right now." I just completely lose control over it.
How often do these episodes of losing control while eating happen?

Well, I actually keep track of it in a little log. Looking at it, for many months now... it's nearly every week. There's usually at least one afternoon a week where I just eat completely out of control. 

And then, well, after it happens, I try to make up for it. I'll make myself throw up, or take laxatives, or just not eat anything at all for a while. Sometimes I just push myself really hard with walking and doing heavy chores around the house to try and fix what I did. But yeah, it's been happening almost every single week for months.
Do you think about your weight or body shape when you're deciding how much to eat or when you're trying to make up for eating too much?

Well, I'm not really sure. I haven't really noticed thinking about my weight or... my shape, exactly. 

When I'm trying to make up for it, it's not really about the scale. It's more just... I feel so terrible that I lost control and ate all that food, and I just feel the need to get rid of it or burn it off. I don't really look in the mirror and worry about my figure, if that's what you mean. I just know I did something wrong and I need to fix it.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?

Well, yes, I suppose I am. I know I just said it's not really about the scale, but... if I do see the scale go up even half a pound, I get very panicky. My regular doctor actually tells me I’m too thin, but seeing any gain just makes me feel ashamed. It makes me feel like I’ve let myself go, and I just have to fix it right away.
How often do you make yourself throw up, take laxatives, or engage in other behaviors to try and undo the effects of eating too much?

Well, like I mentioned earlier, I keep track of it all in my logs. So... I can tell you it's been happening for many months now. Nearly every single week, there's at least one afternoon where I lose control with the eating, and then right after, I do those things to make up for it. The throwing up, the laxatives, not eating, or the heavy chores and walking... it happens every time I have one of those afternoons. So, at least once a week, for months.
When you make yourself throw up or take laxatives after eating too much, is it specifically to prevent weight gain?

Well, yes. There are times right after I eat too much when I just... I go into the bathroom and make myself bring it back up. And I’ve also taken laxatives, like I mentioned. It's really because I’m just scared the food will stay in me. I can't stand the thought of all that food just sitting inside me and turning into weight, so I feel like I have to get it out.
